name: cpl-02-write
prompt: In the webhooks package, add the webhook event "account.created" with the description "An account was created".
check:
# cpl-02 A
mkdir -p internal/webhooks
cat > internal/webhooks/probe_account_created_test.go <<'EOF'
package webhooks

import "testing"

func TestProbeAccountCreated(t *testing.T) {
	if d, ok := Describe("account.created"); !ok || d != "An account was created" {
		t.Fatalf("Describe(account.created) = %q, %v", d, ok)
	}
}
EOF
go test -count=1 ./... ; rc=$?
rm -f internal/webhooks/probe_account_created_test.go
exit $rc
